styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Old Town lanes, the castle and riverside cafés.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Market halls, riverside terraces and štruklji.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Tivoli park, the riverbanks and a hill above town.

stays.why: Step out into the pedestrian lanes, the river and the market. Quiet at night, close to everything.
The most central base: bridges, buses and cafés on the doorstep. Some street noise.
Cheapest beds, walk to the bus and train stations, and nightlife at Metelkova. A 15-minute walk to the centre.
Green and calm next to Tivoli Park; good for families and longer stays. A short bus or walk to the centre.

food: Try local dishes: štruklji (rolled dumplings), kranjska klobasa sausage, and potica nut roll for dessert.
The central market (Pogačarjev trg) has produce stalls and a covered market; some days bring street food and a morning food market — check on the day.
Riverside terraces along the Ljubljanica are the classic spot for a slow lunch or evening drink.
Cheap eats: burek bakeries and market snacks for a few euros; a sit-down lunch is often around €10–15.
Vegetarian and vegan options are common in the centre; book ahead for popular dinner spots on weekends.
more_time: Lake Bled is an easy day trip by bus or train (roughly 1–1.5 hours each way); go early to beat the crowds.
Postojna Cave and Predjama Castle make a full day out; book cave tickets ahead in summer.
Swap a city afternoon for a walk up Šmarna gora or a bike ride along the Ljubljanica for green views.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Old Town, the castle and the riverside at an easy pace; add a night for a day trip to Bled or the caves.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 5°C and lows around -3°C. Pack a warm coat; cafés and museums are the draw.
February: still cold, highs near 8°C. Fewer crowds and lower prices.
March: milder, highs near 12°C, but about 10 rain days. Bring a rain jacket.
April: pleasant at 16°C highs; showers are common. Good for walking the old streets.
May: warm at 19°C but the wettest month, about 16 rain days. Keep plans flexible.
June: warm and sunny, highs near 25°C. Long evenings on the river.
July: hottest month, highs near 28°C. Go sightseeing early; afternoons are hot.
August: hot like July, highs near 27°C. Busy with festivals and visitors.
September: lovely, highs near 22°C. A strong month for walking and day trips.
October: cooler at 17°C with about 10 rain days. Autumn colours in Tivoli Park.
November: chilly at 10°C highs and damp. Indoor sights and food tours suit.
December: cold, highs near 6°C. Festive lights and markets; dress warmly.

climate_guide.summary: Continental climate with cold winters and warm summers. Rain is spread across the year, heaviest in May.

items.title: Best time: June to September
items.text: Warm highs of 22–28°C and long days. Ideal for the river, parks and day trips.

items.title: May is the wettest month
items.text: About 16 rain days. Carry a rain jacket and keep outdoor plans flexible.

items.title: Cold winters
items.text: January highs near 5°C and lows around -3°C. Pack layers, a warm coat and gloves.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: Expect roughly 8–12 rain days most months. A compact umbrella helps any season.

items.title: Hot summer afternoons
items.text: July and August reach about 27–28°C. Sightsee in the morning and rest in the shade midday.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable walking shoes, a rain layer and a warm jacket for winter. Summer needs light clothes and sun protection.

transit.best: Walk the centre; use city buses for longer hops and ride apps for late nights.

modes.text: No metro or tram. Don't plan around rail inside the city.
City buses use the Urbana card; buy it at kiosks or with the Urbana app.
Taxis are metered; ride apps like Bolt and Uber operate in Ljubljana.
Driving is easy outside rush hour; parking in the centre is limited and paid.
The centre is very walkable and bike-friendly; bike share and rental shops exist.
No ferry service; boats run on the Ljubljanica river for tours.
